text:
lara: quick heads-up — seeing phantom quality spikes on recent quant-eval runs. some examples show repeated predictions, metrics jump then self-corrects. filing because it correlates to retry storms during shard flaps.
kevin: can you paste a small log snippet? curious if it's duplicate processing or reporting glitch.
lara: pasted minimal log below:
```
2026-04-12T15:02:11Z worker-3 processing example_id=abc123 run=2026-04-12T15:02
2026-04-12T15:02:13Z worker-3 timeout lease lost example_id=abc123
2026-04-12T15:02:14Z dispatcher requeued example_id=abc123
2026-04-12T15:02:15Z worker-7 processed example_id=abc123
2026-04-12T15:02:15Z metrics.emit run=2026-04-12T15:02 accuracy=0.92 example=abc123
```
kevin: hmm, looks like two workers processed the same example within a second. that will definitely inflate counts.
samir: probable cause: ack ordering race + lease expiry jitter. when worker loses lease it requeues and another worker picks it up before the first finishes cleanup, so we get double-processing. also our metrics are emitted on success without dedupe guard.
samir: proposal: 1) mark example as IN_FLIGHT with a redis lease key (id:run). 2) only emit metrics when transitioning IN_FLIGHT -> COMPLETED by the same owner. 3) if a requeue happens, set a short tombstone to prevent immediate dupes.
kevin: + add dispatcher-side semaphore/backpressure so we don't requeue hundreds at once during a shard drop. current requeue logic blasts the queue which causes thundering herd.
hao: I can add a CI harness that simulates slow workers and lease expiries. quick sketch for test script:
```
# run many evals and pause some workers to force lease expiry
for i in {1..500}; do curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/eval -d "{\"id\":\"$i\"}" & done
# start 4 workers, kill one after 5s, sleep to simulate slow cleanup
```
This'll assert no more than 1 success per example_id and check metric `dedupe_replays`.
eva-bot: FYI — last CI run failed on `eval-runner-integration` with intermittent duplicates (job 4223). attaching log id: ci/4223-line-:19.
samir: I'll open a small PR with the redis-lease guards. patch will: set `lease_key = example_id:run_id` on start, set owner id, use lua compare-and-set for COMPLETE transition. also add tombstone TTL=10s on duplicate finish.
kevin: can you also add a short-circuit that if we see > X requeues for a run within 30s we surface an alert and stop requeuing? otherwise staging spike will become prod incident.
samir: yep. threshold default 50, configurable.
lara: I'll add a telemetry counter `eval.dedupe_replays` and a dashboard tile. want a chart: replays / minute, percent of examples with >1 processing.
hao: I'll wire CI test into `eval-runner-integration` (flaky -> guarded). test will run in docker-compose worker-sim mode and assert no duplicates for 1k synthetic examples. adding `--force-slow` to simulate leases.
kevin: plan: samir merges patch to canary branch, deploy to staging, hao runs load test, lara watches dashboard for 10m, rollback if error rate or latency > 2x.
eva-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/canary at 2026-04-12T17:00Z by samir.
oncall-bot: reminder — add an alert runbook note about dedupe threshold and manual rollback steps.
lara: assigned: samir (patch & canary), hao (CI test), lara (dashboard), kevin (staging load test). I'll follow up with PR links and timeline. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
kevin: one more ask — include a small end-to-end smoke in CI that asserts order-preserving metric emission for each example. that will catch regressions fast.
samir: agreed. will include lua CAS and a tiny smoke check. targeting PR within 2 hours.
